brand.getBrand.description: The organization's brand kit: accent colour, mark level and web logo.

brand.patchBrand.description: Sets the accent colour and the mark level. Send only the fields to change.

brand.putBrandWebLogo.description: Uploads the web logo as a PNG body, at most 1024 by 512 px and 512 KB. It replaces the current logo.

brand.deleteBrandWebLogo.description: Removes the web logo. The brand kit keeps its other settings.
